acceptance_criteria: A cooling-fan widget exists with fan speed as a visible driven state, exercised by its own widget_studio tab.
description:
NEW WIDGET. Verified 2026-08-13: components/ has cooling_tower.rs but NO fan widget. A cooling tower is not a cooling fan - CIET's CTAH and TCHX are air-cooled heat exchangers with fans whose speed is the control input.

The fan widget must expose fan speed as a driven state, because that is what the PID control acts on in the v2 CIET loop (CTAH and TCHX PID control is what version_2/version_3 of the prototype implement).

Build on the new widget libraries; same frame-cost caution as the heater bead.
title: CIET v3 art: cooling FAN widget — does not exist yet, new build

description:
Maintainer-chosen acceptance for the hybrid API, and it lands BEFORE anything depends on it.

Run a geometry where pure surface, pure delta and hybrid are ALL valid and require all three to agree within statistics. The FHR pebble already validated against OpenMC is the natural case; tests/openmc_notebooks/triso.rs:520 already runs one 3x3x3 geometry through both trackers and is the template.

Second, sharper gate: the hybrid's virtual-collision count inside a bed region must be INSENSITIVE to adding a strong absorber outside it. That is the property the entire design exists for and it is directly measurable.
title: Phase 1.7 GATE: hybrid equivalence V&V

description:
Follow-up from op-fm5 (fixed 2026-08-11). No longer a performance emergency, but still wasteful and still the thing its own doc comment apologises for.

ProportionalController::new (alpha_nightly/controllers/proportional_controller/mod.rs) realises G(s) = K_c as the first-order transfer function (K_c s + K_c)/(s + 1), so a pure multiply goes through a TransferFnFirstOrder, i.e. TWO blocks (FirstOrderStableTransferFnNoZeroes + FirstOrderStableTransferFnForZeroes), three state variables, three exp() calls and the 9-decimal-place input-change guard, every step. Its Default doc at :58 already says 'This is probably overdoing it in terms of computation cost but that is not an issue ... yet ...'.

MEASURED 2026-08-11 (release, AMD Ryzen 5 5600, rustc 1.97.0), after the op-fm5 O(1) rewrite: a bare ProportionalController costs 0.06 us/step, against roughly 1 ns for the multiply it actually represents -- so about 60x overhead, flat. Before the rewrite it was 9.42 us/step. So the fire is out; what is left is tidiness.

PROPOSED: give ProportionalController a direct multiply path (output = K_c * input + offset) and keep the transfer-function representation only where a dead time is actually set, since dead time is the one thing the plain multiply cannot express. Watch out: the current form is NOT exactly a pure gain when a dead time is applied, so check what set_dead_time is expected to do here before simplifying.

Not urgent. Filed so the apology in the doc comment has somewhere to point.
title: chem-eng: ProportionalController still routes a pure gain through the full first-order machinery

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Found 2026-09-10 (session_01AhE6XBx3nRd81aHLQrciQe) via the BROADR light-nuclide golden test: crate RECONR for C-12 (MAT 625) returned MT=1 pairs [(0.0, 4.942347), (0.0, 4.934), ...] where the ENDF tape (n-006_C_012-ENDF8.0.endf MF=3/MT=1 line 4) reads ' 1.00000E-5 4.94234700 1.090516E-5 ...' - Fortran E-exponent fields packed without spaces. src/endf/parse.rs parse_endf_float splits at the first +/- after position 0, giving mantissa '1.00000E' which fails str::parse -> None -> Ok(0.0) (the Hollerith fallback), i.e. every such energy silently becomes ZERO. Tapes with E-exponent MF=3 fields in reference-data/endf: Li-7 (128 lines), C-12 (187), C-13 (266), O-16 (1221). NJOY reads them correctly (NJOY's C-12 PENDF starts at 1.000000-5 / 7.826532+1 broadened). Fix: strip a trailing E/e/D/d from the mantissa before parsing (Fortran also accepts D exponents); add unit tests for '1.00000E-5', '1.090516E-5', '.001000000', '1.5D+3'. Impact: any C-12/O-16/Li-7 processing in this crate (RECONR grids with E=0 points, downstream BROADR/GROUPR/ACER) has been silently wrong at those points.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Fixed 2026-09-10 in the BROADR/broadn commit on agent-w3: parse_endf_float strips a trailing E/e/D/d from the mantissa; unit test endf_float_fortran_exponent_letter covers '1.00000E-5', '1.090516E-5', '.001000000', '1.5D+3', '-2.5e-01', '1.5E5'. C-12 RECONR grid now starts at 1e-5 eV and its broadened elastic agrees with NJOY's PENDF to 1.8e-4.

title: ENDF parser: parse_endf_float silently returns 0.0 for Fortran E-exponent fields ('1.00000E-5') - Li-7, C-12, C-13, O-16 reference tapes affected

description: tampines::components::Condenser::condense and CoolingTower::evaluate both return TampinesError::NotYetImplemented. Consequence for the digital-twin engine widgets (built 2026-08-12): CondenserVisual::new draws the machine with NO temperature or quality colour at all (Condenser stores only an operating pressure and a target outlet quality), and CoolingTowerVisual::new draws no exit air, no cold-water basin colour, no approach and NO PLUME (CoolingTower has a real air inlet, water inlet temperature and flow, plus a target approach set-point, but no outlet state). Both widgets have honest from_scalars paths for callers with their own model state; the physics paths stay deliberately neutral. Implementing Condenser::condense and the Merkel/NTU cooling-tower engine (tampines::cooling_tower) would let the physics-backed paths paint fully.
title: CoolingTower/Condenser: evaluate() unimplemented blocks state-driven artwork

description:
56 lines, one rect coloured by air_inlet.t_dry_bulb (real). Used by NEITHER example -- htgr_sim_v1's schematic imports 9 of 10 visuals and omits this one -- so it has never been exercised in anger. Blocked on op-dt3.17.4 for size.

Quality bar: look derives from the component's real dimensions and live state, not from arbitrary screen coordinates; document units, valid ranges and what drives what in the /// doc comment; add tests; and per the workspace V&V rule state BOTH methodology and measured results where anything is checked against a reference. Do not fabricate a value to render -- an unpopulated component must be visibly distinct from a cold one (PipeVisual's neutral-grey empty case is the precedent).
title: Widget Studio QC: CoolingTowerVisual — near-stub, and unused by both examples
